kill_rules.K1: predicate not met at the landing revision
kill_rules.K2: a battery forgery accepted by the r93 driver, the positive refused, or the r92 driver refusing both forgeries
kill_rules.K3: a genuine row moved by the pin walk, or verify writing under the receipts directory
kill_rules.K4: the PASS skips the work: self-referential pin row, receipt counted without its pin row, or --root ignored

named_limits: a coherent joint edit of instrument, pin, receipt and expectation row survives
the minus-self digest binds table coherence, not authority
pinned bytes are compared at F/C; a script reading outside its own bytes is unseen
a receipt added after C is RECEIPT_UNPINNED; a removed receipt row stops being scored with its expected row
PRIOR_ACCEPTED is measured in the tree-only r92 form; a --repo r92 run binds receipts to a revision, which is a different mechanism
